Cb.bar_b_note: The serpent model is a credible naturalistic base, but A's muddy gold mottling loses the read at small size and B's faint poses float off the ground in a rising coil, so neither reaches Palworld creature finish.

Sw.bar_b_note: The side camera and big armoured badger read well, but frozen idle bodies under hits and a flat olive-yellow grade with no sky, fog or cool distance sink it.

Zl.bar_b_note: A high top-down camera over a uniform grass carpet, with the player creature mostly off screen and wild swings in f12-f14, means the fight does not read as a Palworld-class battle.

Rb.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with expressive eyes and a coherent green-brown homestead palette that matches shipping stylised character finish, though he is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Yo.bar_b_note: Apart from one possible stagger (A f24), both creatures hold their idle silhouettes under flat lavender telegraph domes and 2D gold hit rings, all shot from a high camera under a muddy yellow grade.

Ei.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, brace, cap and stone footing start to read as built, but the wall is still a lone thin card on a flat grass carpet beside a low-poly rock, and B is a blank white sheet.

Hp.bar_b_note: The arena framing with fence and banners is readable, but creatures that stay frozen under hits, smoke that blankets the target (A f30-f31), the camera inside foliage (A f28) and a one-note yellow grade sink it.

Al.bar_b_note: B's larger, unclipped blue-grey panel nears a shipping UI, but its keyboard-glyph hints are small and plain, and it sits over a murky grey night scene with no Valheim-class mood.

top_changes.change: Author and trigger real hit-react, stagger and locomotion body poses (flinch, recoil, lean, rear) for the combat creatures so a hit or a move visibly changes the silhouette, and ground the serpent's faint poses on the floor

Fix the production fight camera to a consistent low over-the-shoulder framing that keeps the player creature, enemy and trainer on screen (no top-down swings, no foliage in front of the lens, smoke that never hides the target), and regrade the Meadows fight away from flat olive-yellow toward warm grass, a real value range and cool blue distance
Ship the homestead wall in the A-style construction (timber frame, brace, cap, stone footing) with real thickness and a textured, mid-value wattle/daub infill instead of a pale card
